fields.Szenariobeschreibung: The distance between power plant Datteln 4 and the mixing plant at Scholven for the transport of EFA-Füller D4 is 37 km and the distance between the silo for BM-Füller Scholven and the mixing plant is 500 m. The distance between the the mixing plant to the gate of Scholven power plant is also 500 m. An electricity dataset from hard coal is employed to depict the electricity supply at the power plant. No CO2 certificates were considered. Excluded are the manufacturing of capital equipment, construction undertakings, and infrastructure development, along with the maintenance and operation of capital equipment. Additionally, activities related to personnel, as well as energy and water consumption associated with company management and sales, are also excluded.
